title: Deep6mA: A deep learning framework for exploring similar patterns in DNA N6-methyladenine sites across different species.
summary: The full study trains a CNN plus bidirectional LSTM on rice 6mA sites and evaluates transfer to three other plant species; it reports over 90% prediction accuracy and shared sequence-pattern/motif evidence across species. This is an exploratory in-silico biological pattern result using existing datasets, not experimental validation of methylation sites.
